usage: 衣架 (ji1 gaa3) is a noun and refers to an item used to hang clothes.
You can use 衣架 when talking about organizing or storing clothes at home.
The word 衣架 is typically used for physical hangers, not digital or metaphorical ones.
In sentences, 衣架 usually appears as the object that holds clothes or other garments.
You can describe different types of 衣架 by adding adjectives before it, such as 木製 (wooden) or 鐵製 (metal).
